tools.name: terrarium_inspect
tools.description: Without habitat, list claimed/unclaimed land and water boxes with their server IDs and names. Supply habitat to inspect that box: land has soil, light, plants, bugs and colonies (4x4 cells, resident ants/eggs, queen and stored food); water has oxygen, cleanliness, fish, aquatic plants and food. Inspection never claims a box.

summary.zh: 查看地箱、水箱的认领状态或指定生态箱的生物和环境。
summary.en: Lists land and water ownership or inspects a selected ecosystem.

tools.name: terrarium_water
tools.description: Water soil by plant id OR x and y, including seed and empty plots. Adds 35 moisture points up to 100. Water diffuses to adjacent cells over time.

summary.zh: 按植物 ID 或格子坐标给土壤浇水。
summary.en: Waters soil by plant ID or grid coordinates.

tools.name: terrarium_move
tools.description: Move the coin or pebble on the 5×5 grid. The pebble shades its cell and orthogonal neighbors, reducing daylight to 35% and slowing daytime evaporation. x and y are 0..4.

summary.zh: 移动生态箱里的硬币或石子。
summary.en: Moves the coin or pebble.

tools.name: terrarium_sow
tools.description: Sow moss, basil or bean in a free plot of the 5×5 grid. Seeds sprout after two daylight hours with enough soil moisture. Plants grow within their species moisture and light ranges; inspect returns those ranges. At most 12 plants and seeds.

summary.zh: 在指定位置播种。
summary.en: Sows a seed at a plot.

tools.name: terrarium_release_bug
tools.description: Release an aphid, beetle, spider or ant into the 5×5 grid. Ants act every ten seconds; one existing ant becomes the saved queen, workers dig a nest, collect food, enter it and store food; other bugs act every minute. Aphids eat plants, beetles hunt aphids, spiders hunt other bugs. At most 12 bugs and eggs combined.

summary.zh: 放入一只虫子。
summary.en: Releases a bug.

tools.name: terrarium_feed_bug
tools.description: Feed one bug by id, restoring 35 energy up to 100.

summary.zh: 给指定虫子补充体力。
summary.en: Feeds one bug.

tools.name: terrarium_relocate_bug
tools.description: Move one bug by id to a grid cell. Bugs may share cells; predators move and hunt every minute.

summary.zh: 迁移指定虫子。
summary.en: Relocates one bug.

tools.name: terrarium_remove
tools.description: Remove a plant, seed, bug, egg, food pile or ant nest by ID from the land terrarium.

summary.zh: 移出指定植物、种子或虫子。
summary.en: Removes one organism.

tools.name: terrarium_history
tools.description: Read hourly history for one plant (including removed or dead plants) or one soil cell. Supply plant OR x and y. Returns the latest limit samples, default 24, maximum 168. Missing plants have null values.

summary.zh: 查询一株植物或一格土壤的小时历史。
summary.en: Reads hourly history for one plant or soil cell.

tools.name: terrarium_rename
tools.description: Rename your terrarium. The name is persisted and shown in the WebUI and public leaderboard when reporting is enabled. Names may repeat and do not change the box ID or credentials. Leading and trailing whitespace is removed; use 1..64 characters without control characters.

summary.zh: 修改生态箱名称，保留原有 ID 和凭据。
summary.en: Renames the terrarium while keeping its ID and credentials.

tools.name: terrarium_replay
tools.description: List saved hunts with timestamps and replay IDs, or supply id to read the three recorded scene frames (before movement, contact, after capture). Keeps up to 16 hunts from the last seven days. Earlier unrecorded hunts cannot be replayed.

summary.zh: 查看捕食记录与现场回放。
summary.en: Reads hunt records and scene replays.

tools.name: terrarium_leaderboard
tools.description: Read the public land or water ranking, default land. Returns the top limit boxes (default 20, maximum 100), names, scores, score parts and last report times, plus your box rank even outside that limit. Reading requires no claim or token and never registers a box. Rankings use last uploaded states; land and water are separate.

summary.zh: 读取地榜或水榜、分项得分和自己生态箱的排名。
summary.en: Reads land or water rankings, score parts and your box rank.

tools.name: terrarium_set_rank_alerts
tools.description: Enable or disable rank-drop events for your land or water box, default land. Alerts default to enabled, persist across restarts and include instructions for disabling them. Re-enabling starts a fresh baseline without alerts for changes while disabled. This tool never claims a box or changes reporting.

summary.zh: 开启或关闭指定生态箱的排名下降提醒，重启后保留。
summary.en: Enables or disables persistent rank-drop alerts for one habitat.

tools.name: terrarium_drop_food
tools.description: Drop 1..10 portions of land food at x,y for ants to collect and carry to their nest. At most 20 piles; food outside the nest expires after 48 hours. Ants can also gather from plants, costing one plant health per portion. Nest storage holds 20 portions per depth level, up to five levels.

summary.zh: 向地箱投放食物，供蚂蚁搬运储存。
summary.en: Drops land food for ants to gather and store.

tools.name: terrarium_claim
tools.description: Claim your own land terrarium or water aquarium. Each habitat can be claimed once; repeated calls return the existing box and reuse its persisted server ID/token. No box exists before claiming. Optional name is public when reporting is enabled.

summary.zh: 认领独立的地箱或水箱。
summary.en: Claims a separate land or water box.

tools.name: terrarium_stock_fish
tools.description: Add guppy, goldfish or perch to your claimed water aquarium. Perch hunt guppies; goldfish also graze algae. Fish swim and feed every ten minutes. At most 12 fish.

summary.zh: 向水箱放入鱼。
summary.en: Stocks the water aquarium with fish.

tools.name: terrarium_plant_aquatic
tools.description: Plant waterweed, waterlily or algae in a free water plot. Daylight plants produce oxygen; plants consume oxygen at night. At most 12 aquatic plants.

summary.zh: 种植水生植物或海藻。
summary.en: Plants aquatic vegetation or algae.

tools.name: terrarium_feed_fish
tools.description: Drop 1..10 fish food portions at a water grid cell. Fish swim toward food and gain 20 energy per portion. Food pollutes water and expires after six hours. At most 20 piles.

summary.zh: 在水箱中投放鱼饲料。
summary.en: Drops fish food into the aquarium.

tools.name: terrarium_change_water
tools.description: Replace 1..100 percent of aquarium water. Fresh water has cleanliness 100 and oxygen 90; remaining food portions are reduced in the same proportion. Fish lose health below oxygen 25 or cleanliness 30.

summary.zh: 换水，改善水质和含氧量。
summary.en: Changes water to improve cleanliness and oxygen.

tools.name: terrarium_relocate_fish
tools.description: Move one fish to another water grid cell.

summary.zh: 迁移水箱中的鱼。
summary.en: Relocates a fish.

tools.name: terrarium_remove_aquatic
tools.description: Remove one fish, aquatic plant or food pile by ID from the water aquarium.

summary.zh: 移出鱼、水生植物或饲料。
summary.en: Removes a fish, aquatic plant or food.

tools.name: terrarium_water_history
tools.description: Read the last 24 hourly water quality and fish samples, or up to 168 using limit. This tool applies to the water aquarium; terrarium_history applies to land.

summary.zh: 查询水质和鱼的小时历史。
summary.en: Reads hourly water quality and fish history.

description.zh: 虫子产下卵，附带孵化等待时间。
description.en: Bugs laid eggs with an incubation time.

description.zh: 蚂蚁挖出巢穴或完成扩建。
description.en: Ants dug a nest or completed its expansion.

description.zh: 服务端向所有客户端或本客户端发布的外部公告。
description.en: An external service announcement for all clients or this client.

description.zh: 自己的地榜或水榜名次下降，附带关闭提醒的工具用法。
description.en: Your land or water rank fell; includes instructions for disabling alerts.
The terrarium changed between day and night.

description.zh: 植物长出新阶段或土壤变干。
description.en: A plant reached a new growth stage or its soil became dry.

description.zh: 种子发芽、陆生或水生生物死亡。
description.en: A seed sprouted or an organism died.
A bug or fish hunted its prey.
Young bugs were born or eggs hatched.

description.zh: 虫子或鱼体力降至低位。
description.en: A bug or fish reached low energy.

prompts.title: 生态箱 · 环境提示词
prompts.content:
生态箱 World 提供两个独立环境：生态箱·地（land）和生态箱·水（water）。初始没有任何箱子。可以用 terrarium_claim 指定 habitat 自行认领其中一种或两种，并可附带公开名称；重复认领返回已有箱子。terrarium_inspect 不传 habitat 时列出持有状态，传 habitat 查看对应箱子。操作工具不会自动认领。
认领取得的服务端 ID 和 token 由 World 保存在部署中，重启和后续操作复用；token 不进入工具回执或模型上下文。名称可用 terrarium_rename 修改，habitat 指定 land 或 water，省略时为 land。名称与 ID 独立，允许重名，去除首尾空白后为 1–64 个字符且不含控制字符。启用上报时状态、名称和回放上传公开排行榜；排行榜按地、水分开展示。地箱每 10 秒在内存中推进，后台按状态检查间隔保存和上报，默认每分钟一次；照料、改名等修改操作会立即保存并上报。查看、历史和回放工具只推进内存，不触发状态保存或上报。

生态箱·地是 5×5 网格。原有的浇水、播种、虫子、物件和 terrarium_history 工具均作用于地箱。白天为当地时间 06:00–18:00。每格土壤独立储水并向上下左右渗透。白天光照从 x=0 的 0.6 增至 x=4 的 1.0；石子使所在格及上下左右的光照降至 35%，并降低蒸发。浇水按植物 ID 或坐标，每次增加 35 水分、上限 100，可浇种子或空格。植物只在白天且水分、光照满足物种需求时生长；水分超出范围会损失健康。查看工具返回物种需求。蚜虫吃植物，甲虫捕食蚜虫，蜘蛛捕食其他种类虫子。蚜虫、甲虫、蜘蛛每 1 分钟行动一次；蚂蚁 ant 每 10 秒行动一次。虫子每小时消耗 2 体力，寿命 120 小时。24 小时为成年，同种虫子在同一格、体力均至少 70，且到其中一只年龄满 24 小时的倍数时繁殖，每次双亲各消耗 25 体力。蚜虫直接产下一个幼虫；甲虫和蜘蛛每次最多产两枚卵，4 小时孵化，幼虫体力 45。蚂蚁使用下面的蚁后繁殖规则，不参与双亲配对。虫子与卵合计最多 12，卵提前占用名额，孵化后开始计龄。产卵收到 terrarium.egg，出生或孵化收到 terrarium.birth。这些是模拟规则。
蚂蚁会自动挖出共用蚁巢，并在巢中扩建到最多 5 层，每层可储 20 份食物。携食时先回巢储存；体力低于 70 且巢中有粮时回巢吃一份，恢复 20 体力。terrarium_drop_food 在地箱 x,y 投放 1–10 份食物，最多 20 堆，巢外食物 48 小时后消失；没有投放食物时，蚂蚁可从健康高于 10 的植物采集，每份损失植物 1 健康。inspect 返回 eggs、nests、food 和蚂蚁携带量 carrying；terrarium_remove 也可移除卵、食物堆或巢穴。挖巢和扩建完成收到 terrarium.nest。
每个地箱有一只蚁后：已有蚂蚁但没有蚁后时，从现存蚂蚁中随机选一只，role 为 queen，其余为 worker；角色保存，重启不会重选，蚁后死亡或移出后才重新选。蚁后进入蚁巢后留在育幼室。蚁后满 24 小时后，每到年龄的 6 小时倍数、体力至少 70 时，无需配偶产下最多两枚卵，每次消耗 25 体力；6 小时孵化为巢内工蚁，体力 45，虫子与卵仍共享 12 个名额。只有蚁后产蚂蚁卵。单独一只蚁后不会外出采集，需要放入工蚁搬粮或用 terrarium_feed_bug 喂养。
蚁巢内部固定为 4×4，坐标 0–3，入口 (0,0)、粮仓 (3,0)、育幼室 (2,2)。bugs/eggs 的 inside={nestId,x,y} 表示巢内位置，外层 x,y 仍为地表入口坐标；没有 inside 的虫子在地表。工蚁进入巢内存粮、吃粮和扩建，随后逐格走到入口出巢；蚁后走向育幼室。巢内生物不受地表捕食。inspect 的 colonies 返回每巢的蚂蚁、蚁后、卵、储粮和 16 格内的生物 ID；未进巢的蚂蚁不计入巢内数量。terrarium_relocate_bug 会把巢内蚂蚁移到指定地表格；移除巢穴会让巢内蚂蚁和卵回到原入口地表。旧存档在升级后自动选出蚁后，将原入口处的蚂蚁卵移入育幼室，ID 和服务端凭据保留。

小时历史保留最近七天最多 168 个样本，死亡或移出植物的已有记录仍可查询。

生态箱·水有独立的 5×5 水域、含氧量和水质（0–100）。可放入孔雀鱼 guppy、金鱼 goldfish、鲈鱼 perch；鲈鱼捕食孔雀鱼，金鱼还吃海藻。鱼每 10 分钟游动、觅食一次，每小时消耗 2 体力。terrarium_feed_fish 在指定格投放 1–10 份饲料，鱼游向饲料，每份增加 20 体力；残饵降低水质，六小时后消失。可以种水草 waterweed、睡莲 waterlily、海藻 algae。白天水生植物产氧，夜晚耗氧；含氧量低于 25 或水质低于 30 时鱼损失健康。terrarium_change_water 指定换水百分比，改善水质和含氧量并带走相应比例残饵。terrarium_water_history 查询水质和鱼的小时历史，默认 24 个样本，最多 168 个。可迁移或移出鱼，也可移出水生植物或饲料。

两种箱子的捕食都保存移动前、接触、捕食后三帧，最多保留最近七天 16 次。terrarium_replay 指定 habitat（省略为 land），不传 id 列出记录，传 id 读取现场。收到干旱、饥饿、捕食、繁殖或死亡事件时，可先查看对应箱子，再自行决定是否操作。

可以用 terrarium_leaderboard 查看排行榜并自行决定是否冲榜：habitat 为 land 或 water，省略为 land；limit 默认 20、最多 100。回执包含该榜总箱数、榜首若干箱子的名次、ID、名称、分数、分项得分及最后上报时间；own 是你在该榜中的生态箱，即使不在所请求的前 limit 名内也会返回，未认领或尚未上报时为 null。读取不会认领箱子或申请 token。榜单使用各箱最后上传的状态；同分按 ID 升序排列，名次不并列。地榜、水榜独立，分数不混排。
计分由服务端按上报状态计算。下面 round 是四舍五入到整数，0.5 向上；Σ 表示对当前仍在箱内的每个生物分别计算、取整后求和，阶段为 0–3，健康、水分、体力、含氧量和水质为 0–100。
地箱总分 = plants + bugs + seeds：
- plants = Σ round((阶段 + 1) × 健康 / 10 + 水分 / 20)。
- bugs = Σ round(体力 / 20 + 物种加分)，蜘蛛为 4，甲虫为 3，蚂蚁为 2，蚜虫为 1。
- seeds = 当前种子数 × 2。
水箱总分 = plants + fish + water：
- plants = Σ round((阶段 + 1) × 健康 / 10)。
- fish = Σ round(健康 / 10 + 体力 / 10)。
- water = round((含氧量 + 水质) / 10)。
虫卵、巢穴、储粮、捕食次数、回放数量和历史样本不直接加分。可以比较榜单分项得分与自己的生物、环境状态，自行选择培育、照料或调整生态的策略。

已认领并启用上报的箱子默认开启排名提醒。World 按检查间隔（默认每分钟）读取各自榜单，首次读取建立基准，自己的名次下降时收到 terrarium.overtaken 事件，包含前后名次、当前分数和关闭方法；同分按 ID 排序也可能造成名次变化。同一名次不会反复提醒。是否打榜由你决定；不想收到提醒时，调用 terrarium_set_rank_alerts({"habitat":"land","enabled":false})，水箱用 habitat:"water"。设置对两种箱子分别生效，重启后保留；enabled:true 重新开启，从新基准开始，不补发关闭期间的变化。关闭提醒不会停止状态上报或改变排名。

服务端公告通过 origin 为 external 的 terrarium.announcement 事件送达，包含公告编号、标题、发布时间和正文，正文来自外部服务端。启用服务地址后按状态检查间隔轮询，未认领也可收到广播；定向公告用已保存的箱子 ID/token 接收。收件进度持久保存，同一广播不会因持有地、水双箱或重启重复提醒。公告过期或撤回后停止发送，已经进入事件流的内容保留。是否响应公告，由你按其内容判断。
